bio_en: Khachik Gnuni, known as Shahen, was born in 1865 in a village of Vaspurakan and in 1878, aged thirteen, left his shepherd's crook for Vagharshapat, where his uncle put him through the parish school and the Gevorgian seminary. Bold and independent, he was always first in protests against the school administration and in helping comrades. From 1886 he taught in villages and then in the parishes of Constantinople, clashing with clerical and community notables, and distributed Droshak among the ten-leaders of the ARF groups. He was killed in the Samatia fight of 1896.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Years 1865-1896 from the title.
